body.name: Wang measurable endpoint-selection box
body.construction:
Let \(L^0(P_X)\) denote equivalence classes, modulo \(P_X\)-null sets, of measurable profile-score functions.  Define
\[
\mathcal B_W(P_{\mathrm{obs}})
:=\left\{g\in L^0(P_X):
b_{1,z}(r)-b_{0,z}(r)-u_{0,z}(r)
\leq g_z(r)\leq
b_{1,z}(r)-b_{0,z}(r)+u_{1,z}(r)
\quad P_X\text{-almost surely}\right\}.
\]
